text:
Eve T: Heads up — NovaScale sent invoice NS-1209 for $3,600 but our system marked it as a duplicate of NS-1187. The vendor included PO IDs PO-44321 in the body and PO-44322 in the line items (looks like they swapped POs).

Sam L: Can you paste the invoice and the vendor ref? I'll check duplicate detection logs.

Eve T: Invoice NS-1209, vendor ref NV-77X. Attached: ns_1209.pdf. The duplicate flag is weird because NS-1187 was already paid for $3,600 last month. Numbers match exactly.

finance-bot: Automated alert: Incoming invoice NS-1209 flagged as "possible_duplicate" (match score 0.92 to NS-1187). No exact PO match for PO-44322. Suggested actions: 1) verify with vendor whether this is a reissue/credit, 2) if duplicate, request credit memo, 3) if different PO, manual split and match.

AP Queue: From AP: Hold payment until vendor confirms. If vendor confirms reissue, they must provide credit for NS-1187 or a signed statement explaining duplicate. Also confirm which PO this invoice should be applied to.

NovaScale Billing: Hi Eve — apologies. NS-1209 was issued because PO-44322 was updated after NS-1187 was created; our system inadvertently reissued the same total to the new PO. We can: a) cancel NS-1209 and issue a credit for NS-1187, b) reissue two invoices (one reversing 1187 and one new for PO-44322), or c) provide a vendor statement clarifying mapping. Which is preferred?

Eve T: We need a clean audit trail. Preferred: issue a credit referencing NS-1187 and then a new invoice explicitly tied to PO-44322 with new invoice number. Keep dates as-is and include PO numbers in text.

Sam L: If they credit NS-1187, AP can process the credit and then accept a fresh invoice for PO-44322. Please make sure the credit memo number is linked to the original payment. Also confirm bank remittance details if refund is needed.

NovaScale Billing: Understood. We'll issue credit CN-1187-1 referencing NS-1187 and then issue NS-1215 for PO-44322 with identical line items. We'll keep remittance details the same; refund not necessary since we'll offset future invoices. Uploading docs in portal when ready.

Priya S: Note — PO-44322 is in my approval domain (Research). Once NS-1215 is uploaded and shows PO-44322 in text, I'll approve.

finance-bot: System note: Created follow-up task for vendor docs. Status: awaiting_vendor_action. Due: 2 business days (2064159600). Duplicate hold placed on NS-1209.

AP Queue: Confirming: do not release payment for NS-1209. If vendor uploads CN-1187-1 and NS-1215, AP will clear holds and route for approval. If vendor instead uploads a signed statement, AP needs an explicit mapping table.

NovaScale Billing: Uploaded CN-1187-1 and NS-1215 to portal: https://files.novascale.example/CN-1187-1.pdf, https://files.novascale.example/NS-1215.pdf. Both include PO numbers in text.

finance-bot: Files received. OCR matched PO-44322 on NS-1215 and found credit memo CN-1187-1 referencing NS-1187. Auto-match suggestion: link CN-1187-1 to NS-1187 and NS-1215 to PO-44322.

Sam L: I'll run the reconciliation job now and clear the duplicate flag.

AP Queue: Reconciliation complete. CN-1187-1 applied to NS-1187. NS-1215 created and matched to PO-44322. NS-1209 remains as 'vendor-error' and will be archived. Approver routing: NS-1215 -> Priya S.

Priya S: Approved NS-1215. Leaving note on PO-44322: "Approved after vendor credit and reissue. Audit docs stored."

Eve T: Thanks everyone — closing ticket. Leaving internal note: monitor NovaScale invoice exports for reissue frequency; escalate if repeat occurrences > 2 in a month.

finance-bot: Thread closed: NS-1209 resolved via CN-1187-1 and NS-1215. Audit trail: files stored under invoices/novascale/2026/NS-1215 and credits/2026/CN-1187-1.
